revision_context: New Irminger and West Spitsbergen regional cases, declared before source fields. Reuse the cloud-validated fixed-latitude v2 collector, geometry, exact-read transport, selection and connected-layer operators unchanged.
geometry_provenance: Fourteen OSW exploratory fixed-latitude windows follow the retained western Reykjanes Ridge and West Spitsbergen regional reference corridors. Longitude gates are editorial choices, not digitized velocity axes, source hydrographic sections, isobaths, whole widths or uncertainty intervals. The Irminger selector may switch between two cores; WSC searches may include Front Current, recirculation or other branches. No independent core/branch/water-mass assignment is performed.
column_selector: Frozen complete finite native 0–200 m signed northward trapezoidal-integral selector, primary 10 cm/s and surface >5 cm/s. Fixed 0-degree true component through depth for both currents. Greatest integral wins; first western native index breaks ties. Keep all candidate and local-maximum metadata. Selected gate/support edges, no qualifying flow and primary-depth censoring remain gaps; no gate/cutoff/direction tuning, weaker interior substitution or alternate-cutoff filling.
temperature_policy: No temperature field retrieval or gate for these cases. Only velocity dataset and coordinates used.

current:irminger.branch_scope: Partial northward eastern Irminger Sea branch along the western Reykjanes Ridge flank, 56–65 N editorial gates. Source describes two cores and intermediate return flow; one local integral maximum is not their summed transport, a uniquely tracked core or a whole-current section. Source also includes deeper northward IC water: a connected velocity contour does not separate upper mode water from deep water masses. Exclude return toward Greenland, North Icelandic continuation, interior gyre circuits, opposite ridge-side current and detached eddies as target identities; broad gates do not independently resolve them.

current:west-spitsbergen.branch_scope: Partial northward West Spitsbergen slope-current corridor from 73 N editorial Barents-departure approach to 79.6 N pre-branching gate. Exclude upstream Norwegian Atlantic routes, Barents inflow, offshore Front Current feeder, recirculation, shelf/fjord intrusions and downstream Svalbard/Yermak/Yermak Pass branches as target identities. Broad northward maxima do not independently resolve these branches or Atlantic Water membership. Source 1,000 m glider limit is not a current bottom; 20–500 m averaged velocities and source water-mass thresholds are not adopted as model layer boundaries. Spitsbergen Atlantic naming is not merged.
